reasoned_events.mechanism: Discount-rate channel: hawkish (hikes / higher-for-longer) pressures long-duration growth and rate-sensitive REITs, mixed for banks via curve; dovish (cuts / cooling hike odds) inverts those duration sides and often supports gold. Labor prints move Fed path expectations without being a ‘jobs ETF’ trade.
reasoned_events.amp_damp: Sides flip on dovish vs hawkish; unknown polarity → no hard book
